card.name: Mixed: Spanish del and 'le' inside words
card.fires_on: Strongest on 'del' in the Spanish phrase 'mantengase fuera del alcance de los niños'. Also on 'le' starting words like leavening, lemniscus, leach, leaguer, and on digits in tonnage figures.

modes.label: Spanish warning
modes.description: The word 'del' (or 'fuera') in the Spanish keep-out-of-reach-of-children warning.
modes.example: Advertencias: Venta bajo prescripción médica, mantengase fuera<< del>> alcance de los niños. No utilizar

modes.label: Word-start 'le'
modes.description: The piece 'le' beginning a rarer English word such as leavening, leach or leaguer.
modes.example: They<< le>>ach out of many products, can last

modes.label: Payload numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a launch mass figure before a unit like t or kilograms.

card.plain: It fires on a Spanish safety phrase and on the 'le' start of some uncommon words, with no shared meaning.
